file_resolution.consumer_gate: Android external-AI selection requires a nonempty non-__ Script; StepCreateScript selects AISExternal and LuaManager::AddFile must find the path in its resource provider. Missing files fail the load.
file_resolution.evidence: Android IDA pseudocode: CharAI::StepCreateScript 0x3cf04c reads AITable Script length at row+40 and name at row+44, calls CharAI::SetScriptByName 0x3ceeb0 for nonempty names, then sets scripted=1. SetScriptByName sends non-__ names to AISExternal and preserves the authored name. The external owner assigns path data/scripts/ai/ (port/level-world/reference/character-script-owner/NOTES.md, Stage 2). LuaManager::AddFile 0x37b23c joins that path and the name, appending .luac when no .lua substring exists; it returns false on a missing stream and suppresses a duplicate load per LuaScript.
